gaps.sentence: No sooner ___ the contract been signed than problems arose.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect passive with inversion: had … been signed.

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ the bridge unsafe, but it was also far too narrow.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only was the bridge unsafe' — inverted past simple of be.

gaps.sentence: Reluctant ___ she was to intervene, the referee stopped the match.
gaps.explanation: Fronted adjective + though/as + subject is emphatic concession: Reluctant though she was…

gaps.sentence: Not only ___ she won the marathon, but she also broke the course record.
gaps.explanation: 'Not only has she won' — inversion with the present perfect auxiliary.

gaps.sentence: So convincing ___ his argument that nobody objected.
gaps.explanation: So + adjective at the front: was his argument that…

gaps.sentence: ___ I known about the deadline, I would have hurried.
gaps.explanation: Had I known = If I had known — inversion replaces 'if'.

gaps.sentence: Only when the audit was complete ___ the accounts released.
gaps.explanation: Only when X happened were the accounts released — inversion after only when.

gaps.sentence: Hardly had we left the house ___ it started to pour.
gaps.explanation: Hardly … when — fixed pair; 'than' belongs to 'no sooner'.
